## About
American Air-Customs is based in Irving, Texas. We focus on residential work: air-conditioning and heating repair, new A/C installs, and appliance repair. Our techs take the time to answer your questions and make sure you're satisfied with the work.
When it's time for a new system or an upgrade, we can walk you through your options. We stock and install HVAC units and filters, and we're an authorized dealer of Amana and Rheem systems.
Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating on Google from 260 reviews, and Joe and Ron come up by name. Give us a call and let us answer any questions you have.

## Services
- A/C and heating repair: Diagnosis and repair for home air-conditioning and heating systems. One reviewer said Joe is very patient and very good at diagnosing all kinds of HVAC problems.
- Air-conditioning installation: New systems and upgrades for your home, including Amana and Rheem units.
- Appliance repair: Repair and installation for home appliances. One customer said Joe fixed her leaking washing machine and explained what to watch for in the future.
- Air purification systems: Air purification systems for your home, plus name-brand air filters.
